help.How to play:
How to play

  • Reach the gold finish pad at the end of the course.
  • Mint-green pads are checkpoints - fall or burn and you respawn at the last one.
  • Red is lava. Cyan platforms move - ride them. The spinning red bar kills: jump over it as it passes.
  • Coins are optional bragging rights. The timer is not.
help.Keyboard and mouse:
Keyboard and mouse

  • W A S D move, Space jump (hold to hop), Shift sprint.
  • R respawn at the last checkpoint, Esc back to the menu.
help.Touch:
Touch

  • Drag on the left side to move (push all the way forward to sprint). Drag on the right side to look.
  • JUMP jumps (hold to keep hopping). Menu (tap twice) returns to the menu.
  • Buttons can be moved and resized: Options > Customize touch controls.
